Reference Form 
 
To be completed by the referee. 
 
This reference should be completed by a faculty member in an academic field closely related to the 
applicant’s major. Please complete the form in either English or Japanese, and return it in a PDF format to 
the applicant. The form must be submitted on a letterhead. The applicant will be responsible for  uploading 
the form onto the NUPACE online application system.  
 
Name of  applicant:       
Department/School:       
 
1. How long have you known the applicant? In what capacity? 
      
2. Please rate the applicant’s academic ability in comparison with students at the same level of study. 
 
A.  Top 5% B.  Top 10% C.  Top 25% D.  Top 40% E.  Other 
 
3. Please rate the applicant in the following areas, using a scale of  1 to 5.  
(5: Excellent, 4: Good, 3: Satisfactory, 2: below average, 1: Not able to assess) 
A. Maturity       E. Communication skills  
B. Motivation       F. Ability to work independently  
C. International Outlook       G. Adaptability to a new environment  
D. Creativity       
 
4. Please give your candid opinion regarding the applicant’s academic performance, strengths, weakness and character. 
(Minimum 150 words in English/ 75 characters in Japanese.)
